releaseNotes:
PotFlix v3.0.0:
• Complete Redesign: Modern glassmorphic Settings screen with categorized controls and Telegram community chat (https://t.me/PotFlixx)
• Redesigned TMDB metadata modal and matching skeleton loading effects
• Subtitle Player Fix: Full local .srt/.vtt file loading and dynamic subtitle overlay rendering
• Authentication & Guest Mode: Onboarding sign-in prompt, one-tap Guest Mode, and Forgot Password recovery
• Smart Network Detection: Clear Wi-Fi server reachability guidance and seamless Offline playback
• Crash Fixes & Optimization: Fixed series/movies scrolling crash and enhanced 4K MediaCodec streaming
